shared_elements: incised/carved surface markings on a vertical stone face
small repeated schematic signs or motifs arranged in rows/registers
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces bear shallow incised marks organised loosely into horizontal registers of small repeated signs, which is a generic feature many unrelated traditions produce. A depicts a three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with distinct curvilinear motifs (paired rings, crescent/arc, loops) laid out symmetrically on a body, while B is essentially a flat panel dominated by dense lines of script-like signs with at most a faint quadruped near the top, so the subject matter is fundamentally different.
